provenance.candidate_reuse: Dense and Nori rankings/scores reused; no translation, Nori retrieval, or dense embedding inference

provenance.test40_policy: No Test40 translation, retrieval, reranking, or tuning

dense15_nori5.label: Dense Top-15 + Nori Top-5
dense15_nori5.definition: Dense ranks 1–15, then unique Nori ranks 1–5, then unseen Dense ranks 16–20 until 20; final fallback unseen Nori; internal order preserved
